segments.name: Conversational AI
segments.description: Provides secure, enterprise-grade conversational AI solutions that connect human intent to enterprise systems and workflows for business customers.
segments.evidence: We are an artificial intelligence company focused on the engagement layer of AI, where human interaction connects directly to enterprise systems, workflows, and real-world outcomes.

revenueModel.text: The company is largely pre-revenue; customers pay for configurable enterprise AI Agent offerings, such as its entry-level community cloud AI Agent offering.
revenueModel.evidence: In November 2023, we acquired our first healthcare customer through our entry-level community cloud AI Agent offering.

changes.text: In 2023, the company acquired DM Lab Co., LTD., through which it acquired its initial conversational AI technology.
changes.evidence: In 2023, we consummated our acquisition of DM Lab Co., LTD., through which we acquired our initial conversational AI technology and foundational capabilities.

changes.text: In 2025, the company terminated its exclusive global automotive reseller agreement with AFG Companies, Inc.
changes.evidence: In January 2025, we terminated our relationship with AFG Companies, Inc. and subsequently announced the termination publicly, along with the initiation of legal action.
